prompt:
Add durable parcel holds across the existing model, JSON snapshot storage,
service, HTTP API and CLI. This is a five-layer feature: holds must survive
reopening the store, appear on existing reads, and be changed through the same
service by both clients. Do not replace the application or add a separate hold
database. Follow every public signature, JSON/error shape, normalization rule,
idempotency rule, revision rule and persistence guarantee in README's Hold
feature contract. In particular use service.Desk.PlaceHold and ReleaseHold,
POST/DELETE /v1/parcels/{id}/hold, and CLI hold/release. Hold values must be copied
at storage boundaries, old snapshots must remain readable, and save failures
must not publish partially changed in-memory state. Update operator/storage
documentation for the commands and durable behavior.

Visible tests: `go test ./...`.
